importantFindings.reproduction: With synthetic rows, open the real current desktop database in a second page wrapped in that historical D3 guard with writer version 0.4.0. Import a same-ID course through the visible D4 preview, acknowledgement and replacement button, setting the selected student's initial note to 'imported replacement note'. The historical guard then successfully writes 'late D3 note' to that same ID; querying the real engine returns the late value. The 5.1-second audit test asserts this observed boundary, not successful stale-writer protection. It uses the exact historical guard with the current pinned real browser engine, not a complete historical application build.
